confidence_notes: Food and coffee use recent 2026 Kuala Lumpur cost-of-living medians. comparable_city_reasoning: Dining anchors use Kuala Lumpur cost-of-living data; accommodation estimates reflect Kuala Lumpur's urban traveler market and general Southeast Asian capital-city context.
